name: Moreno Valley Mall
summary: Moreno Valley Mall is a traditional enclosed regional shopping center featuring brand-name retailers, a food court, and entertainment options including a 16-screen Harkins Theatre and bowling alley. This community-focused mall serves as the primary retail destination for Moreno Valley and surrounding Inland Empire areas.
demographics: Moreno Valley Mall serves a diverse, family-oriented community in the Inland Empire with a median household income below the California average, attracting primarily middle-income shoppers. The trade area draws heavily from young families and Hispanic households, which represent a significant portion of Moreno Valley's population. Typical visitors are value-conscious consumers seeking affordable fashion, entertainment options like the Harkins 16-screen cinema and bowling, and convenient dining at the food court. The mall serves as a primary retail destination for residents within a 15-mile radius who prefer one-stop shopping experiences.
description: Moreno Valley Mall stands as the premier enclosed shopping destination in Moreno Valley, California, serving the growing Inland Empire community since its opening. This traditional regional mall offers a comprehensive retail experience with brand-name stores, a full-service food court, and exceptional entertainment amenities including a Harkins Theatres 16-screen multiplex cinema and bowling alley. Located at 22500 Town Circle, the mall provides convenient access for families and shoppers throughout Riverside County seeking a classic mall experience. The center maintains regular operating hours Monday through Saturday from 11:00am to 8:00pm and Sunday from 11:00am to 7:00pm, with extended holiday hours to accommodate seasonal shoppers. With its mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues, Moreno Valley Mall continues to serve as a vital community gathering place and retail hub for the region.
